name: Imp and original hero sprite remaster
review: The user accepted the faithful original-guided 4x imp, then the corrected complete action set on 2026-10-14: This looks good. So Imp is done. Original pose authority and front-dig pickaxe-head correction remain part of the contract.
scope: Local sprite experiment with per-animation texture-resolution metadata in the shared renderer. No gameplay-rule changes.

overheadWalkTest.checks: PNG transparency and six distinct unclipped frame crops verified. Six-frame GIF verified. Browser review tested idle/walk switching, pause/play, frame stepping and 2x/8x display scale.
overheadWalkTest.assessment: User accepted this overhead idle and six-frame walk. It remains the style reference for the expanded set.

expandedSet.generationMode: Built-in image generation with original poses and accepted enhanced sprites as references
expandedSet.packing: Whole connected sprites are extracted across nominal cell boundaries. A shared scale and translation per sequence fit the original bounds; native anchors are retained. Conversion uses the engine palette and alpha cutoff. All 65 packed overhead frames have a transparent border.
expandedSet.runtimeObservation: The actual creature uses the HD idle, walk and dig animations at sprite_size 300. Original-action fallback and entering/leaving possession passed. DX12 reported no rejected frames or validation errors/warnings.
limitations: New art covers idle, walk and digging only.
Possession and other actions retain original local game data.
Hands-on campaign art review remains; this is an opt-in local playtest.
The runtime ZIP contains original possession frames from local game data and must remain local.
expandedSet.recommendedNextStep: Play the opt-in DX12 imp preview, review movement and digging during ordinary dungeon play, then fill the remaining original-art actions using the accepted style.

possessionFollowup.scope: Imp possession artwork; historical overhead, held and hero acceptance above remains separate.
possessionFollowup.preservation: Original archive members, prior enhanced frames, overhead and held metadata remain exact. Native timing, anchors, aliases and gameplay configuration are unchanged.
possessionFollowup.registration: One uniform transform per action/direction, followed by one original-derived tone mapping shared by the complete action. Generated alpha is retained; it is not claimed identical to native masks.
possessionFollowup.staticReview: Independent source/geometry/alpha checks and original-paired native/4x visual review passed. Drag direction 1 required a final face/material consistency repair.
possessionFollowup.runtimeStatus: Exact 191-frame archive passed 464 matched stages with zero DX12 errors, warnings or rejections and exact restoration. Combined v23 Enhanced and Original launch checks passed with the API disabled.
possessionFollowup.remaining: Other 29 models retain 3,012 native possession frame uses. Natural job acquisition, hauling, combat and broad campaign play remain separate from directed renderer checks.
possessionFollowup.resume: Present the opt-in v23 comparison for appearance review. Preserve this exact package; ordinary artwork selection remains unchanged. Do not infer appearance approval from the earlier CTA approval.
